s: The water in the bathtub sloshed.
Das Wasser schwappte aus der Badewanne.

to splash, to slop, to squirt
Sie schwappte sich Wasser ins Gesicht.
She splashed water on her face.

Some water spilled out of the bucket.

The boat shipped water and nearly capsized.
